patch_list: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from Google Play. Required for Video Cutter: its PairIP local installer check is live, so a re-signed build fails the license check without it — keep it on.
Removes all ads, as if the Remove Ads purchase were bought. Also enable the Change installer source patch (pre-selected).
